notes.title: v4.2 - Aim Down Sight & Health Bar
notes.content:
Aim Down Sight
After countless requests, you can now finally aim down the sights of your gun. Doing so will stop you from sprinting; however, it will increase your accuracy and reduce your recoil, allowing you to make more precise shots—especially useful in the early waves. Once you upgrade to akimbo, you will no longer be able to aim down the sights.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/4233977aa4acdcc3257f2282a5aad76bed0c2d3d.png"]Health Bar
Also after countless requests, there is now a Health Bar, which appears below the Kinetic Energy Bar. The bar’s colour changes dynamically based on your current state:

Low Health: If you are low on health and the next hit would kill you, the bar turns dark.

Immunity Frames: If you get hit and are temporarily invulnerable, the bar flashes brighter.

Vitality Surge: If your health is boosted above the maximum, the bar becomes pink.

Necrovore Active: If Necrovore is active, the bar becomes a brighter and whiter.

Retribution Active: If Retribution is active, the bar turns yellow. (The golden outline around the wave number has been removed; this is now how you’ll know Retribution is active.)

notes.title: v4.0 - DEADZONE
notes.content:
DEADZONEIntroducing the newest game mode: Deadzone
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/46f1ae0379cd1857ee92053c9d35845146ce6f4b.png"]

Deadzone is a whole new way to play Nasty Zombies, locking you into a specific area of the map that shifts with each wave.

Follow the Skull — it marks the Deadzone. Stay within its radius to stay safe, but stray too far and you’ll start taking damage. Unblocking more zones will make the Deadzone more forgiving.

This is a more challenging way to play Nasty Zombies, and you will be heavily rewarded. For every wave you complete, the Skull will give you coins; the higher the wave, the more coins you will receive.

You can also claim the Deadzone Skull as your own, and wear it as a head; reach wave 100 in the Deadzone game mode to acquire it!

notes.title: v3.0 - Enter the Backrooms
notes.content:
Enter the Backrooms
This month marks the one-year anniversary of Nasty Zombies, and we're celebrating in the best way possible — with a brand new map: The Backrooms.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914133/44364abd8144847e175797a31736c3a9bbe7fbda.png
Now, I know what you're thinking — this isn't The Farm. That’s still on the way and very much in progress. But in the meantime, The Backrooms should give you something fresh (and freaky) to sink your teeth into.

This isn’t just a reskin of The Church. The Backrooms plays completely differently.
There are no waves. No breaks. Just floors — and your goal? Descend as deep as you can into the endless, ever-changing maze.

Each floor brings new layouts, new tension, and new challenges. The deeper you go, the more unstable the environment becomes. Will you adapt... or will you become just another lost soul wandering the yellow halls?

In other news...

While slow, it delivers massive damage with each swing and boasts high penetration, making it perfect for crushing hordes. Every hit lands with bone-shattering force, tearing through nasties in a gory, satisfying display of carnage.

notes.title: v2.34 - The Decayed Update
notes.content:
The Decayed Update
This update shakes up gameplay with Decay, a brutal new zombie wave that forces you to rethink your strategy. We've also added a brand-new movement ability, Air Dash, giving you more mobility in combat. The Marathon perk is gone—stamina is no longer a concern, so you can sprint endlessly. A fresh perk, Kinetic Recovery, takes marathons place, it rewards movement with faster healing.

New Wave: Decayed
The nasty just got even nastier. In "Decayed" waves, zombies will spawn decayed, with missing arms, and sometimes, even without a head, yet they’ll keep coming for you like nothing happened. They don’t need eyes to hunt you down, so stay sharp, switch up your strategies because these relentless husks won’t go down easily.

notes.title: v2.24 - Chronomotion & Fortify Rework
notes.content:
Chronopulse & Fortify Rework

Chronopulse (formerly Chronomotion)
Chronomotion was an exciting concept, but in practice, it slowed the game down too much, often leading players to disable it. I've now reimagined it as Chronopulse.

In this updated version, time slows down only when Nasty Zombies are dangerously close, giving you the chance to escape intense situations without interrupting the flow of gameplay.

Fortify
Fortify’s original function of repairing all barricades was helpful but unintentionally slowed the game, forcing players to wait as zombies broke through again.

Now, Fortify not only repairs barricades but also enhances them with an electrifying edge. When zombies attack fortified barricades, they’ll take damage and eventually die.

Bug Fix
Sten headshot counter now shows correct value.

notes.title: v1.0.17b
notes.content:
Changes


Leaderboard now shows top 10 instead of top 5.
Weapon wall lights now have no collision to prevent getting trapped under them.
Power-ups now fade in and fade out.

notes.title: v1.0.17
notes.content:
Leaderboards!

Leaderboards are here, you can now compete with your friends and the world for the spot at number 1!

notes.title: v1.0.16
notes.content:
New Features

 Overhauled the stats screen.
 Stats screen now displays how close you are to mastering a weapon.
 Added global leaderboards, you can now see the top 5 global records.

notes.title: v1.0.15
notes.content:
New Features

 Footstep sounds are now different depending on what surface you're walking on.
 Added hints around the map to inform of game mechanics.

Changes

 Run energy depletes slower and is able to be reactivated faster.
 Reworded some achievements and UI elements.

notes.title: v1.0.14
notes.content:
New Settings


Added music volume slider.
Movement keys are now rebindable.
Weapon use key is now rebindable.
Added toggle sprint option.

Changes


You now walk faster in the score room.

notes.title: v1.0.13
notes.content:
NEW

Dynamic Music System
Coins have random colours and glow
Coin collection sounds are now directional
Select Map Button added to Main Menu
Nasty Zombie spawn rooms in the basement now have walls

notes.title: v1.0.12
notes.content:
New


Added inverted Y axis support.

notes.title: v1.0.11
notes.content:
Changes


You now get more money per Nasty Zombie pre-wave 25.
Winchester and M134 weapon and ammo prices increased to compensate.
Nasty Zombies always face the barricade when breaking it.
Removed the toggle flashlight prompt.
Resized some UI elements.

Bugfixes


Nasty Zombie speed now scales correctly post wave 100.

notes.title: v1.0.10
notes.content:
Changes


The Shotgun weapon class now has no damage falloff with bullet penetration.
Crate room has more consistent viable layouts.

notes.title: v1.0.9
notes.content:
Changes


Further changes to M134 room making it more spacious.
Tweaked how Chronomotion functions.

notes.title: v1.0.8
notes.content:
Changes


New Pillar in M134 room allowing for more diverse room layouts.
Significantly more diverse room layouts from the Winchester room.
Hardened flesh now regens health at the same rate as normal health instead of faster.
Nasty Zombies legs are now more fragile at lower waves.
Nasty Zombies now take less bleed damage from losing limbs.
Nasty Zombies will now unstick themselves faster if they're unable to move.
Nasty Zombies will no longer make the arm swing sound if they died whilst attacking.
Zillionaire and Fragile Fortune now makes multiple coins drop instead of the value of a single coin increasing.
Added deadzones to controllers to prevent stick drift.
Chalkboard in score room will now display hours longer than 1 digit in length.
Adjusted the Wave and Zombie amount count to work better with different screen sizes.

notes.title: v1.0.7
notes.content:
New Features

NEW ACHIEVEMENT ADDED: 50 Under 50

Bug Fixes


 Removed the central pillar in the M134 room to prevent Nasty Zombies getting stuck out of the players reach.
 Fixes Nasty Zombies attacking barriers after they had died.

notes.title: v1.0.6
notes.content: Added controller support!

notes.title: v1.0.5
notes.content:
Nasty Zombie Limb health now scales with waves.

Chicken Nugget Zombies now stay alive.

Fixed a bug where the score chalkboard was displaying one less wave than what the player actually reached.

notes.title: v1.0.1
notes.content: Fixed a bug in the Lee Enfield room where zombies could get stuck if you were on top of the high wall.
